test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, and S are sitting on a bench facing south. A. B, C and D are sitting on a parallel bench facing north. S and B are sitting opposite to each other. A sits exactly in between D and C. P sits opposite to C. Q sits immediately to the left of S. Which of the following is correct about the position of R?

options.text: R sits to the immediate right of Q
R sits to immediate left of P

solution:
As per the given information,

1) P, Q, R, and S are sitting on a bench facing south.

2) A, B, C and D are sitting on a parallel bench facing north.

3) Q sits immediately to the left of S.

4) S and B are sitting opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e4617a1e8d6343e3a68519cd0e46e3209d03f42a4d6f3f52ef5d7d8d2c1534f.png] 

5) A sits exactly in between D and C.

6) P sits opposite to C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96e32ddc978a8078d9043f444d10f1257511a90f209c0b3a0910157eddc24d18.png] 

Thus, the final arrangement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6ed9a1e3f813c04a4c985b9d22dc37725ba323177fe6ee01fa0420548ab8aa2f.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"R sits opposite to A".**
